message.content: Now let me look at the match function signature and how the heapframe is allocated:

content:
Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/pcre2/src/pcre2_match.c:
   554	match(PCRE2_SPTR start_eptr, PCRE2_SPTR start_ecode, PCRE2_SIZE *ovector,

   556	  match_block *mb)
   557	{
   558	/* Frame-handling variables */

   595	/* This is the length of the last part of a backtracking frame that must be
